claims.label: Theorem 1 (Entropic GW duality)
claims.statement_original:
Fix $\varepsilon>0$, let $(\mu,
u)\in\mathcal{P}_{4}(\mathbb{R}^{d_{x}})	imes\mathcal{P}_{4}(\mathbb{R}^{d_{y}})$, and define $M_{\mu,
u}:=\sqrt{M_{2}(\mu)M_{2}(
u)}$. We have

\[
\mathsf{S}^{2}_{\varepsilon}(\mu,
u)=\inf_{\mathbf{A}\in\mathbb{R}^{d_{x}	imes d_{y}}}32\|\mathbf{A}\|_{\mathrm{F}}^{2}+\mathsf{OT}_{\mathbf{A},\varepsilon}(\mu,
u),
\]
(9)

where $\mathsf{OT}_{\mathbf{A},\varepsilon}$ is the EOT problem with cost function $c_{\mathbf{A}}\mspace{-3mu}:\mspace{-3mu}(x,y)\in\mathbb{R}^{d_{x}}	imes\mathbb{R}^{d_{y}}\mapsto\mspace{-3mu}-4\|x\|^{2}\|y\|^{2}-32x^{\intercal}\mathbf{A}y$. Moreover, the infimum is achieved at some $\mathbf{A}^{\star}\mspace{-3mu}\in\mspace{-3mu}\mathcal{D}_{M_{\mu,
u}}\mspace{-3mu}\coloneqq\mspace{-3mu}[-M_{\mu,\mspace{-3mu}
u}/2,M_{\mu,
u}/2]^{d_{x}	imes d_{y}}$.
